build_atom_type_lookup: build a lookup table from atom type strings to integer indices using atom_order and atom_types
create_residue_id_mapping: create a mapping from single-letter amino acid codes to integer residue IDs using restype_order
test_restype_conversion: test bidirectional one-letter to three-letter amino acid name conversion with restype_1to3 and restype_3to1
summarize_msa_char_encoding: summarize the MSA_CHAR_TO_ID mapping used to encode multiple sequence alignment characters as integer IDs
build_compact_atom_index: build a 21x47 residue-to-atom index array mapping compact atom positions to full atom47 indices using restype_atom47_to_compact_atom
